purpose: Separate projected-model grid sensitivity from the finite-resolution projection/binary response difference before gradient work
comparison_denominator: finer projected response magnitude for grid change; binary response magnitude for model difference
adaptation: Run fixed first, stop batch on physical failure. If either grid indicator exceeds 1%, assess N64 resources and refine before interpreting parameter effects. Between 0.5% and 1%, report conditional resolution; refine if parameter effects have comparable size. No automatic full beta/emin sweep.
